observations.behavior: Checks the warm workspace flag before executing desktop provisioning; execution is skipped if disabled.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a conditional guard around existing PostHog-specific image/repository checks in task provisioning.

observations.behavior: Defines a feature-flag evaluation helper that uses posthoganalytics.feature_enabled with organization-group targeting and local-only evaluation. No external calls are made except to the analytics service.
observations.posthog_connection: Relies on PostHog's internal feature-flag infrastructure without introducing new dependencies or configuration changes.

observations.behavior: Adds unit tests for the warm-workspace flag: one parametrized case checking rollout behavior, another asserting failure-safe fallback when the flag service raises an exception.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests do not depend on live PostHog services; they use mocking of the analytics client, preserving compatibility and safety.

observations.limitations: The change does not demonstrate broader systemic benefit, recovery handling, or adoption metrics. It only establishes a guarded, opt-in capability. The tier cannot be raised above 1 because no wider architectural improvement or risk reduction is shown.

While it could support future improvements, this patch alone demonstrates only a narrow maintenance-like addition rather than a substantive or broad capability enhancement.
